knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Brand familiarity is not among the factors. The other three are the approval, suitability and effectiveness factors.
The guideline names flammability as one of the added hazards. The other reasons are not in the guideline.
The guideline advises against hypochlorite on soft furnishings and uses detergent in its place. Option B matches that advice.

practicalCriteria: Learner reads a product label and states the approved use, the contact time and the protective equipment.
Learner correctly identifies a prohibited product or use from three scenario cards.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Assessor record of the label check
stopWorkCriteria: A product has no label or cannot be matched to the approved list
A product is headed for a surface the label does not list
